traits.name: Death Flood
traits.text: (conjuration, primal, water); When a grodair dies, its body explodes in a blast of pressurized water that deals 4d6 (4d6) bludgeoning damage to creatures within a 15-foot emanation (DC 22 basic Reflex save). A creature that fails its save is pushed 5 feet (or 10 feet on a critical failure).

traits.name: Muddy Field
traits.text: ⬻ (primal, transmutation, water); The grodair transforms all soil, sand, or similar sediment in a 10-foot emanation into mud for 1 round. This mud is difficult terrain for creatures other than grodairs.

traits.name: Organ of Endless Water
traits.text: ⬻ (conjuration, manipulate, primal, water); The grodair causes water to pour from a magical sac on its spine, either a stream of water at a rate of 1 gallon per round, or a fountain in a 5-foot-long stream at a rate of 5 gallons per round. It can stop the flow of water as a single action.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ water jet +13 (range increment 60 feet); Damage 3d6 (3d6) bludgeoning plus Push 10 feet
